_readme: Trendzact Partners Portal - Global Product Catalog
v6 - Fully priced v1 commercial catalog + complete feature copy
- 8 GA modules priced (SWA/SIA/eDLP $180, ITM/SVM/MSR $120, SR-QAM/ECS $80)
- CORE $25K flat, CARE $20K base (x careMultiplier), INIT-ONBRD $25K base (x presaleMultiplier)
- Bundle discount FORMULA-BASED: 15% per module from 2+, caps at 45%
- Multi-year continuity: 15% Year 2, 30% Year 3
- PRIVSCR is per-user $20/user/yr service on SWA + SIA
- OBSRVR-DET is per-user $15/user/yr on SWA
- Meeting connectors $8K each (TEAMS/ZOOM/WEBEX/GMEET), CONN-PURVIEW $15K (multi-parent)
- 5 Platform Options: PLAT-AWSACC $75K / PLAT-AWSBCP $40K / PLAT-PBK $20K / PLAT-SOC $30K / PLAT-BI $15K
- 5 One-Time: INIT-DPIA $20K / INT-OKTA $8K / INT-PING $8K / INT-GRAPH $12K / INT-SPLUNK $10K
Naming conventions:
INT-*    one-time setup/integration (category 30)
CONN-*   recurring connector (category 20)
PLAT-*   platform option (category 25)
INIT-*   one-time initialization/assessment (category 30)
Allowed displayBadges values (v1):
REQUIRED  - auto-included, un-toggleable (blue in wizard)
NEW GA    - recently promoted to GA, visible and selectable (green in wizard)
- Checkbox is disabled (cursor not-allowed)
This file is served at /catalog.json with Cache-Control: no-cache.
Schema spec: product-catalog-schema-v1.md
Framing update:
- User-facing category label '10-Module' should be interpreted as Data Exposure Coverage.
- User-facing category label '20-Module Option Recurring' should be interpreted as Extended Coverage.
- User-facing section label 'Included Features' should be rendered as Risk Detections for category 10 coverage SKUs.
- User-facing section label 'Optional Add-Ons' should be rendered as Extended Coverage.
Discover-card framing update:
- Category 10 SKUs can be rendered as buyer-facing Data Exposure Coverage cards.
- Card names are scenario-based and map back to existing SKU codes; no new field names required.
- features.included should render as Included Detections.
- features.optionalAddOns should render as Enhancements.
- Some cards reference related SKUs in optionalAddOns to support cross-sell/discovery; pricing engines should continue to use selected SKU codes only.
GA production update:
- All Data Exposure Coverage cards are GA / production selectable.
- No category 10 coverage SKU carries a BETA badge.
- Former beta coverage cards remain active and selectable under the same schema.
Category 20 content alignment update:
- Category value remains '20-Extended Coverage Option' for schema and UI compatibility.
- User-facing names/descriptions are aligned to the Enhancements concept.
- UI may continue to render Category 20 as Enhancements while preserving the category string.

bundleDiscount._doc: Discount applies only to Modules that have bundleEligible:true and are not BETA. n=count of selected eligible modules. discount% = min(maxPct, max(0, (n - startAtCount + 1) * perModulePct)). So n=1 -> 0%, n=2 -> 15%, n=3 -> 30%, n=4+ -> 45%.

multiYearContinuity._doc: Applied to recurring totals. Year 1 = full price. Year 2 = (1 - 0.15) of Year 1 recurring. Year 3 = (1 - 0.30) of Year 1 recurring.

skus.name: GRC1 Core Platform
skus.description: Unified edge-first governance, risk, and control platform. Required for every Trendzact deployment. Includes edge agent, embedded decision engine, monitoring profiles, and SOC operations framework.

included: Edge agent and decision engine
Monitoring profiles and policy authoring
SOC operations framework
Audit and evidence ledger

skus.name: Care Support with aligned SLA
skus.description: Ongoing support and SLA tiered by client size. Includes incident response, upgrade management, and advisory hours.

included: 24x7 incident response
Upgrade and patch management
Quarterly advisory review
SLA aligned to company size

skus.name: Workspace Exposure
skus.description: Protects sensitive data where it is physically visible in the workspace. Detects webcam-visible risk conditions such as phones, paper, unattended screens, observers, and non-compliant work areas—and applies real-time controls to reduce exposure.

included: Phone, camera, or recording device visible near sensitive work
Paper documents, handwritten notes, or exposed materials near the user
Sensitive screen visible while workstation is unattended
Unauthorized observer, shoulder-surfing, or unknown person present
Clear-desk or clean-screen policy violation
Sensitive work occurring in uncontrolled physical environments

skus.name: Identity Spoofing and Imposter Access
skus.description: Protects sensitive sessions when login credentials alone are not enough. Uses continuous facial recognition, presence assurance, and liveness signals to detect imposters, proxy work, credential sharing, and identity uncertainty in real time.

included: Logged-in user does not match the person present
Authorized user leaves and another person continues the session
Face, liveness, or presence signal conflicts with expected identity
Credential sharing, proxy work, or session handoff suspected
Imposter presence detected during sensitive activity
Step-up verification required due to identity uncertainty

skus.name: High Risk Exposure based on User Time, Place, and Application
skus.description: Protects sensitive data at the moment it appears on screen. Detects restricted, labeled, or high-risk content visibility across displays and applies real-time masking, watermarking, restriction, or control.

included: Sensitive information appears on screen
Labeled or restricted data becomes visible
Sensitive content appears on secondary displays
Unauthorized screenshot, screen capture, or recording condition detected
Data visibility requires mask, restrict, or watermark action
Screen exposure exceeds policy threshold
Sensitive activity occurs at unusual time of day
User operates from unexpected, restricted, or anomalous location
Application usage deviates from normal baseline
Sensitive application opened with unusual supporting tools
Activity pattern suggests staging or exfiltration preparation
Work session includes unexplained idle, active, or location gaps
Unproductive or unexplained computer activity periods
Geolocation anomalies and jurisdiction crossings
Policy-restricted work location conditions
Activity gaps requiring exposure review
Work activity occurs outside expected time-place pattern

skus.name: Insider Threat Exfiltration Behavior
skus.description: Protects against negligent, malicious, or collusive insider behavior before it becomes data loss. Detects staging, suspicious handling, external transfer indicators, and activity patterns requiring containment or SOC review.

included: User accesses sensitive data outside normal pattern
Sensitive files or screens staged before transfer
High-risk application sequence observed
Clipboard, screenshot, upload, or external app behavior indicates risk
User behavior crosses containment threshold
Insider activity requires case creation or SOC review

skus.name: Virtual Meeting & Screenshare Exposure
skus.description: Protects sensitive data during virtual meetings and screen sharing. Detects Microsoft Teams and other meeting exposure scenarios, including MIP/AIP-labeled content visibility, external participants, unauthorized observers, and recording governance risk.

included: Sensitive data exposed during MS Teams screen sharing
MIP/AIP or Microsoft Purview-labeled content visible in meeting context
External or unauthorized participant present while restricted data is visible
Unknown participant, observer, or attendee identity risk
Screen sharing continues after sensitive content appears
Meeting recording or evidence governance risk

skus.name: Multi-Screen Recording
skus.description: Multi-screen recording for quality assurance or defensible evidence when exposure occurs. Records and links screen activity to events so teams can reconstruct incidents, support regulated review, and prove what happened.

included: Exposure event requires defensible evidence
Screen activity must be reconstructed
Multi-display session requires capture
Alert-triggered event requires linked screen evidence
Compliance review requires retained proof
Investigation requires event-linked visual timeline

skus.name: Evidence Retention Enhancement
skus.description: Enhances exposure coverage by retaining screen, alert, and interaction evidence after risk occurs. Supports investigation, audit review, and compliance validation when proof must be preserved.

skus.name: Continuous Capture Enhancement
skus.description: Enhances evidence coverage by capturing full-session on-screen activity. Supports complete reconstruction when regulated review or high-risk operations require continuous proof.

skus.name: Alert-Triggered Capture Enhancement
skus.description: Enhances evidence coverage by capturing screen activity only when exposure risk is detected. Provides focused proof for real-time alerts without requiring continuous recording.

skus.name: Speech-to-Text Evidence Enhancement
skus.description: Enhances quality and compliance review by converting voice interactions into searchable records. Supports investigation of exposure-related conversations, QA scoring, and regulated review.

skus.name: Geolocation Anomaly Enhancement
skus.description: Enhances location and activity exposure coverage by alerting on unusual locations, jurisdiction crossings, and policy-restricted regions that increase exposure risk.

skus.name: Privacy Screen Enhancement
skus.description: Enhances workspace exposure coverage by reducing screen visibility to unintended observers. Helps limit visual exposure in shared, hybrid, and uncontrolled environments.

skus.name: Ultrawide Webcam Enhancement
skus.description: Enhances workspace exposure coverage with an ultrawide webcam to improve visibility of the physical workspace, including phones, paper, observers, unattended screens, and surrounding exposure conditions.

skus.name: Observer Detection Enhancement
skus.description: Enhances workspace exposure coverage by detecting unauthorized observers near sensitive activity. Flags shoulder-surfing, unknown presence, and observer-driven exposure risk in real time.
